exploratory.description: Vague, browsing-style queries with little specificity.

precision.description: Highly specific lookup queries with concrete identifiers (years, brand names, model numbers, named makers, exact materials).

style.description: Stylistic or period-driven queries that express a design language without naming a specific item.

visual.description: Visual/aesthetic descriptors focused on colour, shape, ornamentation or material appearance.

examples.query: blue ceramic vase with floral pattern
carved wooden box with brass inlay
red velvet armchair with curved back
